text:
Carmen (Hiring Manager): Heads up  new SWE starting next Tues. Can we lock down a "first-week quickstart" that managers can copy? Need access checklist, 30/60/90 bullets, and a manager expectations blurb.
Eli (People Ops): Draft below. Trying to keep it copy-paste friendly for Slack.
Noah (IT): Ordering a macbook. Carmen DM shipping address pls. Also confirm MDM vs local dev VM.
Sofia (Buddy): Will run day1 repo tour and day3 pair. Happy to be buddy.
Liam (Eng Lead): I'll add to repos, infra groups, and CI permissions. Also recommend assigning a tiny first PR.
Eli (People Ops): First-week quickstart manager snippet:
```
Pre-day: confirm device, send welcome DM with calendar invites
Day 0: HR forms, Slack intro, confirm access (email, SSO)
Day 1: product & tech overview (buddy + mgr), repo access test
Day 2: tiny first ticket, pair with buddy
Day 3: cross-team intros, metrics & monitoring tour
Day 4: ownership areas, 30/60/90 expectations shared
```
Carmen (Hiring Manager): Nice. Can you also add quick manager expectations?
Eli (People Ops): Manager expectations short: weekly 1:1 for first 8 weeks, clear milestones & decision boundaries, weekly slack check-in until ramped. Also set a feedback loop at 2 & 4 weeks.
Noah (IT): ETA on laptop 4 business days. If urgent I can provide cloud dev env.
Sofia (Buddy): Adding a "who to ask" doc: code -> Liam, infra -> Devops, support -> #support, metrics -> Data Eng.
Liam (Eng Lead): I'll create a first small issue that validates CI + local dev. Carmen, want me to assign it day 1?
Carmen (Hiring Manager): Yes assign it day1. Eli, please attach the 3 quick success signals for 30/60/90.
Eli (People Ops): Quick success signals: 30: completed onboarding ticket & documented learnings; 60: independent PRs and owned bugfixes; 90: led a small feature and improved monitoring or performance.
onboard-bot: Reminder: "Device provisioning" scheduled for 2024-07-01 09:00.
Noah (IT): I've sent SSO invites to the provided email. Carmen confirm if special SaaS (Figma, Posthog) needed.
Carmen (Hiring Manager): Posthog yes, Figma no.
Eli (People Ops): I'll publish this as "first-week-quickstart" in onboarding templates. Carmen  please confirm calendar invites and mentor in place by EOD Friday.
